definitions.explanation: The act of serving others selflessly, often without compensation. Used for community service, religious service, and charitable activities.
A discounted sale, often used in retail contexts where goods are sold at reduced prices as a service to customers.

examples.japanese: {地域|ちいき}に{奉仕|ほうし}する。
{毎週|まいしゅう}{土曜日|どようび}にボランティア{奉仕|ほうし}{活動|かつどう}をしている。
examples.english: I do volunteer service activities every Saturday.

examples.japanese: {社会|しゃかい}{奉仕|ほうし}の{精神|せいしん}を{大切|たいせつ}にしている{団体|だんたい}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: I joined an organization that values the spirit of community service.

examples.japanese: {奉仕|ほうし}{品|ひん}コーナーはどこですか。
{年末|ねんまつ}の{奉仕|ほうし}セールで{安|やす}く{買|か}えた。
examples.english: I was able to buy it cheaply at the year-end bargain sale.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{毎月|まいつき}{一回|いっかい}、{奉仕|ほうし}{価格|かかく}で{商品|しょうひん}を{提供|ていきょう}している。
examples.english: This store offers products at bargain prices once a month.

notes:
USAGE:
The core meaning is selfless service to others. In sense 1, it appears in contexts like community service, religious ministry, and charitable work. In sense 2, it is used in retail — the idea being that the store is "serving" customers by offering discounts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社会|しゃかい}{奉仕|ほうし} (community service)
- {奉仕|ほうし}{活動|かつどう} (service activities)
- {奉仕|ほうし}{品|ひん} (bargain goods)
- {奉仕|ほうし}{価格|かかく} (bargain price)
- {無償|むしょう}{奉仕|ほうし} (unpaid service)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- サービス: broader "service" including customer service — {奉仕|ほうし} implies selflessness or sacrifice
- ボランティア: volunteer work — {奉仕|ほうし} is more formal and traditional
